resources.string: Keeps this device reachable for PhoneConnect telemetry and remote sessions.
Enter the URL of your PhoneConnect hub and a one-time enrollment token from your administrator. Enrollment pins this device\'s identity; the credential is stored sealed by the Android Keystore.

Recovery: PhoneConnect is an ordinary app, so Android and battery managers can still stop it. If it stops, open this screen and press Enroll and connect; allow notifications so the connection status stays visible.
Enrolled as %1$s. Starting the connection service.
Not enrolled. Enter your hub URL and enrollment token.
%1$s\nThe system refused the last background start: %2$s. Open this screen to reconnect.
Enrolled as %1$s. The system refused the background start: %2$s. Open this screen to reconnect.
Not enrolled (%1$s). Enroll again to reconnect.
Screen capture is off. A snapshot command answers consent_required until you enable it here.
Screen capture is enabled. Android cannot keep this grant across a restart, so enable it again after the app restarts.
Screen capture was not granted. The snapshot command stays unavailable.
Brightness changes: not allowed\nDo Not Disturb changes: not allowed
not allowed — use the button above and allow it in Android settings
Background reliability: not exempt from battery optimisation
Android exempts this app from battery optimisation.
Android did not say whether this app is exempt; assume it can still be stopped.
Android may still stop this app to save battery. Use the button above and allow it; without the exemption the agent reconnects when it can, but it can be stopped.
Android did not open that settings screen on this device, so the grant cannot be given here.
